svg.text: 6-stage RISC201 pipeline: IF | ID | OF | EX | MA | RW
and or not lsl lsr asr
taken? beq bgt b call ret
write back rd (or ra for call)
newest of MA, RW, reg file
ld in EX and its rd used in OF
stall: hold PC, IF/ID, ID/OF; bubble into EX
Load-use: 1 stall. Taken branch: 3 instructions flushed. ALU -> ALU dependences: forwarded, no stall.
Clock period is set by the slowest single stage (EX), so it is shorter than the 4-stage design.
